sections.headline: Period homes in South Manchester, painted properly
sections.subheadline: Wallpapering, sash windows and heritage colours across Didsbury, Chorlton and Sale.

sections.title: Family on every job
sections.body: Hartley & Sons is a father and two sons. No subcontractors, so the people who quote are the people who paint.

items.name: Interior decorating
items.description: Walls, ceilings, coving and woodwork, rooms left tidy each evening.

items.name: Wallpaper hanging
items.description: Lining paper, feature walls and hand-trimmed designer papers.

items.name: Sash window restoration
items.description: Stripped, filled, primed and painted to keep original timber sound.

items.name: Exterior painting
items.description: Render, fascias and front doors in breathable masonry paints.

items.author: Helen Whitworth
items.text: Our Victorian hallway was a nightmare of old paint. They made it look like it did in 1890.

items.author: James Pemberton
items.text: Punctual, polite and the wallpaper joins are invisible.

items.author: Aisha Karim
items.text: Gave a clear quote and stuck to it. Lovely to have in the house.

sections.headline: Let's look at your rooms
sections.body: We'll visit, look at the job properly and send a fixed written quote.
